relation_role_structure.common_identity: personal/family security: current security state + retrospective change versus last year
prerequisite_findings: q105/Q105 measure current personal/family security state.
te105 measures retrospective change in that exact personal/family security object.
State and change are distinct temporal components; no latent scale/additivity is inferred.
relation_role_structure.basis: Exact source semantics and revalidated R8C authority establish differentiated state/change roles converging on the narrow personal/family security proposition.

relation_role_structure.common_identity: gendered military service: good-experience evaluation + civic-obligation judgments by gender and peace/war condition
prerequisite_findings: obfe/obme items are bounded civic-obligation judgments under peace/war and gender conditions.
Distinct evaluation and obligation roles converge on military service; this does not authorize T09 reciprocity or T10 matrix.
relation_role_structure.basis: Exact source semantics plus current revalidation of the R8C accepted T11 verdict establish the narrow multi-role convergence.

relation_role_structure.common_identity: felt obligation to protect the environment → concrete intended applications undertaken to protect that same environment (use less electricity; change diet)
prerequisite_findings: Q7NCVB explicitly states the general environmental obligation.
Q7NCVE and Q7NCVF explicitly name concrete conduct intentions “to protect the environment”.
Other frozen members are concern, rights, efficacy/capacity, existence-belief, or generic conduct propositions and are not applications of this exact T03 relation.
relation_role_structure.basis: Exact source text supplies both shores and the same narrow principle; subset is inherited from and revalidated against the R8C bounded verdict, not manufactured from collision proximity.
